market_context: Monday's AI surge is being unwound unevenly: Nvidia and other chip stocks are falling while the Dow has turned positive, and traders now assign 95% odds to a December 25-basis-point Fed hike (finance.yahoo.com). Underlying breadth is constructive, with 637 advancers versus 406 decliners and 12 of 16 sectors higher, but VIX at 28 warrants modest confidence and targets (metacap.si).

predictions.reasoning: SPY has rebounded from $712.14 to near its $720.34 session high instead of extending the opening gap-down. The roughly 1.6-to-1 advance/decline ratio and gains in 12 of 16 sectors support further recovery, although technology's 2.12% decline should cap the advance ([metacap.si).

The Dow's 0.42% gain and position near its $498.21 session high demonstrate clear relative strength versus QQQ's 1.36% decline. Healthcare leadership and broad sector gains favor continued rotation into Dow constituents, while Best Buy's best same-store-sales growth in five years provides a supportive consumer signal (metacap.si; finance.yahoo.com).

The semiconductor slump intensified before the open, with QQQ giving back roughly one-third of Monday's 7% surge and Nvidia, Micron and Analog Devices all under pressure (stocktitan.net). Although QQQ has bounced to $642.16, Nvidia remains down 5.41% and AMD approximately 8%, so heavyweight chip selling could erase part of that rebound by the close.

Nvidia's decline follows an extraordinary 31.48% one-day jump, leaving substantial short-term profits available to be taken (stocktitan.net). Broad confirmation from falling AMD, Micron and Broadcom shares makes continued profit-taking and a close below the $156.12 baseline somewhat more likely than a sustained recovery (finance.yahoo.com).
